description_en: Resets the Access Token of a specified data gateway. The associated Agent and name are retained, and only the plaintext Access Token is regenerated. The old Access Token becomes invalid immediately. The new plaintext Access Token is returned only once in this response. Store it securely right away. Only the creator of the Access Token can reset it, and only Access Tokens issued by the console (source=console) can be reset
description_zh: 重置指定数据网关 Access Token：保留归属 Agent 与名称，仅重新生成明文 Access Token，旧 Access Token 立即失效；新明文 Access Token 仅在本次响应中一次性返回，请立即妥善保存。仅该 Access Token 的创建者本人可重置，且仅支持重置由控制台签发（source=console）的 Access Token
name: ResetAgenticApiKey

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data gateway Access Token to reset. This value is the same as the Id returned by the create and query operations. Only the creator of the Access Token can reset it, and the target Access Token cannot be in a revoked state
parameters.help_zh: 待重置的数据网关 Access Token 的 ID，与创建、查询接口返回的 Id 一致。仅该 Access Token 的创建者本人可重置，且目标 Access Token 不能处于已吊销状态
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the new Access Token starting from the time of this reset, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 31536000 (approximately 365 days). If you do not specify this parameter, the original expiration time of the Access Token is retained. This parameter is required when the target Access Token has already expired. Otherwise, the system retains the past expiration time and issues an Access Token that is invalid upon creation, and the request is rejected
parameters.help_zh: 自本次重置时刻起新 Access Token 的有效时长，单位为秒，取值范围 [1, 31536000]（最长约 365 天）。不传时沿用该 Access Token 原有的过期时刻；当目标 Access Token 已过期时本参数必填，否则会因沿用已过去的过期时刻而签发出生即失效的 Access Token，请求将被拒绝
parameters.name: expire_after_seconds

Data.description_en: The Access Token information returned after a successful reset. The Secret field contains the new plaintext Secret, which is returned only once in this response
Data.description_zh: 重置成功后返回的 Access Token 信息，其中 Secret 为本次一次性返回的新明文 Secret

AgentId.description_en: The ID of the Agent to which the Access Token belongs
AgentId.description_zh: Access Token 所归属的 Agent 的 ID

AgentName.description_en: The name of the Agent to which the Access Token belongs
AgentName.description_zh: Access Token 所归属的 Agent 的名称

AgentType.description_en:
The type of the Agent to which the Access Token belongs. Valid values:
HUMAN_BOUND: fully inherits the permissions of the associated user.
PERMISSION_NARROW: narrows the permissions based on the associated user's permission baseline.
AGENT_BOUND: inherits the permissions of the parent Agent.
STANDALONE: holds permissions as an independent identity principal
AgentType.description_zh: Access Token 所归属 Agent 的类型，取值包括 HUMAN_BOUND（完整继承关联用户权限）、PERMISSION_NARROW（在关联用户权限基线上收窄）、AGENT_BOUND（继承父 Agent 权限）、STANDALONE（作为独立身份主体持有权限）

CreatedAt.description_en: The time when the Access Token was created, in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format (UTC+8). This value remains unchanged after the reset
CreatedAt.description_zh: Access Token 的创建时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss（东八区），重置前后保持不变

CreatorId.description_en: The user ID of the Access Token creator
CreatorId.description_zh: Access Token 创建者的用户 ID

CreatorName.description_en: The display name of the Access Token creator
CreatorName.description_zh: Access Token 创建者的显示名称

Description.description_en: The description of the Access Token. This value remains unchanged after the reset
Description.description_zh: Access Token 的描述信息，重置前后保持不变
Description.example: Access token used by the data analysis agent

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the Access Token, in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format (UTC+8). If ExpireAfterSeconds is specified, the expiration time is recalculated from the time of the reset. If ExpireAfterSeconds is not specified, the original expiration time is retained
ExpireTime.description_zh: Access Token 的过期时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss（东八区）。传入 ExpireAfterSeconds 时以重置时刻重新计算；不传时沿用原过期时间

Id.description_en: The ID of the reset Access Token. This value remains unchanged after the reset
Id.description_zh: 被重置的 Access Token 的 ID，重置前后保持不变

IsRevoked.description_en: Indicates whether the Access Token has been revoked. An Access Token returned after a successful reset is always in the non-revoked state (false)
IsRevoked.description_zh: Access Token 是否已被吊销。重置成功返回的 Access Token 一定为未吊销状态（false）

KeyPrefix.description_en: The visible prefix of the Access Token, which is used to identify the Access Token without exposing the full Secret. This value remains unchanged after the reset
KeyPrefix.description_zh: Access Token 的可见前缀，用于在不暴露完整 Secret 的前提下识别该 Access Token，重置前后保持不变

LastUsedTime.description_en: The time when the Access Token was last used, in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format (UTC+8). This value is empty if the Access Token has never been used
LastUsedTime.description_zh: Access Token 最近一次被使用的时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss（东八区）；从未使用时为空

Name.description_en: The name of the Access Token. This value remains unchanged after the reset
Name.description_zh: Access Token 的名称，重置前后保持不变

Secret.description_en: The new plaintext Secret generated by this reset. This value is returned only once in this response and will not be returned by any subsequent operation. Store it securely right away. The old Secret becomes invalid immediately after the reset
Secret.description_zh: 本次重置生成的新明文 Secret，仅在本次响应中一次性返回，后续任何接口都不会再次返回，请立即妥善保存。旧 Secret 在重置后立即失效

Source.description_en: The credential source of the Access Token. The reset operation supports only Access Tokens issued by the console. Therefore, the value is always console
Source.description_zh: Access Token 的凭证来源。重置接口仅支持控制台签发的 Access Token，因此固定返回 console

Warning.description_en: The reminder information related to this reset, such as a notice that the new Secret is returned only once and must be stored immediately. This value is empty if no reminder exists
Warning.description_zh: 与本次重置相关的提醒信息，例如提示新 Secret 仅一次性返回、须立即保存；无提醒时为空
Warning.example: The new secret is shown only once. Please store it securely now.

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. You can use this code to programmatically determine the failure type. This value is empty when the request succeeds
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误码，用于程序判断失败类型；请求成功时为空

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails. This message helps you locate the issue. This value is empty when the request succeeds
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误描述信息，便于人工定位问题；请求成功时为空

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID, which is used for troubleshooting and log correlation
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与日志关联

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. A value of true indicates that the reset was successful. A value of false indicates a failure. In this case, check ErrorCode and ErrorMessage to identify the cause
Success.description_zh: 本次请求是否成功。true 表示重置成功，false 表示失败，此时可结合 ErrorCode 与 ErrorMessage 定位原因
